description: Defines the TrustStoreInMemory class, a simple in-memory implementation of a TrustStore for managing certificates and trust settings within the Chromium project.

classes.name: TrustStoreInMemory
classes.description: An in-memory implementation of TrustStore that manages certificates and their trust status.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the trust store is empty.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the trust store to its initial empty state.

methods.name: AddCertificate
methods.description: Adds a certificate with specified trust settings.

methods.name: AddTrustAnchor
methods.description: Adds a certificate as a trust anchor based on SPKI and subject.

methods.name: AddTrustAnchorWithExpiration
methods.description: Adds a trust anchor with expiration enforcement.

methods.name: AddTrustAnchorWithConstraints
methods.description: Adds a trust anchor with extracted constraints.

methods.name: AddDistrustedCertificateForTest
methods.description: Adds a distrusted certificate for testing purposes.

methods.name: AddCertificateWithUnspecifiedTrust
methods.description: Adds a certificate with unspecified trust.

methods.name: SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate.

methods.name: GetTrust
methods.description: Retrieves trust information for a given certificate.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is in the trust store.
